171:         &&& self.fc_client@.instance_id() == replica.flat_combiner_instance@.id()

491: /// The ghost context for a thread carying permissions and tracking the state of the update operation
492: ///
493: ///  - Dafny:   glinear datatype ContextGhost = ContextGhost(
494: pub tracked struct ContextGhost<DT: Dispatch> {
495:     /// Token to access the batch cell in Context
496:     ///
497:     ///  - Dafny: glinear contents: glOption<CellContents<OpResponse>>,
498:     pub batch_perms: Option<PointsTo<PendingOperation<DT>>>,
499:

501:     ///
502:     ///  - Dafny: glinear fc: FCSlot,
503:     pub slots: FlatCombiner::slots,
504: 
505:     /// tracks the update operation
506:     ///
507:     ///  - Dafny: glinear update: glOption<Update>
508:     pub update: Option<UnboundedLog::local_updates<DT>>

511: //  - Dafny: predicate inv(v: uint64, i: nat, cell: Cell<OpResponse>, fc_loc_s: nat)
512: pub open spec fn inv(&self, v: u64, tid: nat, cell: PCell<PendingOperation<DT>>, fc: FlatCombiner::Instance, inst: UnboundedLog::Instance<DT>) -> bool {
513:     predicate {
514:         &&& self.slots.key() == tid
515:         &&& self.slots.instance_id() == fc.id()
516: 
517:         &&& ((v == 0) || (v == 1))
518:         &&& (v == 0 ==> self.slots.value().is_Empty() || self.slots.value().is_Response())
519:         &&& (v == 1 ==> self.slots.value().is_Request() || self.slots.value().is_InProgress())
520: 
521:         &&& (self.slots.value().is_Empty() ==> {
522:             &&& self.update.is_none()
523:             &&& self.batch_perms.is_none()
524:         })
525: 
526:         &&& (self.slots.value().is_Request() ==> {
527:             &&& self.update matches Some(update)
528:             &&& update.value().is_Init()
529:             &&& update.key() == self.slots.value().get_ReqId()
530:             &&& update.instance_id() == inst.id()
531: 
532:             &&& self.batch_perms matches Some(batch_perms)
533:             &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().is_init()
534:             &&& batch_perms@.pcell == cell.id()
535:             &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().value().op == update.value().get_Init_op()
536:         })
537: 
538:         &&& (self.slots.value().is_InProgress() ==> {
539:             &&& self.update.is_none()
540:             &&& self.batch_perms.is_none()
541:         })
542: 
543:         &&& (self.slots.value().is_Response() ==> {
544:             &&& self.update matches Some(update)
545:             &&& update.value().is_Done()
546:             &&& update.key() == self.slots.value().get_ReqId()
547:             &&& update.instance_id() == inst.id()
548: 
549:             &&& self.batch_perms matches Some(batch_perms)
550:             &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().is_init()
551:             &&& batch_perms@.pcell == cell.id()
552:             &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().value().resp matches Some(resp)
553:             &&& resp == update.value().get_Done_ret()
554:         })
555:     }
556: }
557: }  // struct_with_invariants! ContextGhost

570:         &self,

578:         &&& local_updates.instance_id() == inst.id()
579:         &&& local_updates.value().is_Init()

1674:     /// Advances the head of the log forward. If a replica has stopped making
1675:     /// progress, then this method will never return. Accepts a closure that is
1676:     /// passed into execute() to ensure that this replica does not deadlock GC.
1677:     #[inline(always)]
1678:     #[verifier::exec_allows_no_decreases_clause]
1679:     fn advance_head(
1680:         &self,
1681:         replica_token: &ReplicaToken,
1682:         // the following were part of the closure
1683:         responses: &mut Vec<DT::Response>,
1684:         actual_replica: &mut DT,
1685:         // ghost state for execute etc.
1686:         ghost_data: Tracked<NrLogAppendExecDataGhost<DT>>,
1687:     ) -> (res: Tracked<NrLogAppendExecDataGhost<DT>>)
1688:         requires
1689:             self.wf(),
1690:             replica_token.wf(self.num_replicas@),
1691:             ghost_data@.advance_head_pre(
1692:                 replica_token.id_spec(),
1693:                 old(actual_replica).view(),
1694:                 old(responses)@,
1695:                 self.unbounded_log_instance@,
1696:                 self.cyclic_buffer_instance@,
1697:             ),
1698:         ensures
1699:             res@.advance_head_post(
1700:                 ghost_data@,
1701:                 replica_token.id_spec(),
1702:                 final(actual_replica).view(),
1703:                 final(responses)@,
1704:                 self.unbounded_log_instance@,
1705:                 self.cyclic_buffer_instance@,
1706:             ),
1707:     {
1708:         let mut ghost_data_new = ghost_data;
1709:         let mut iteration = 1;
1710:         loop
1711:             invariant
1712:                 self.wf(),
1713:                 replica_token.wf(self.num_replicas@),
1714:                 ghost_data_new@.cb_combiner@.value().is_Idle(),
1715:                 ghost_data_new@.combiner@.value().is_Placed() ==> ghost_data_new@.pre_exec(
1716:                     responses@,
1717:                 ),
1718:                 ghost_data_new@.advance_head_post(
1719:                     ghost_data@,
1720:                     replica_token.id_spec(),
1721:                     actual_replica.view(),
1722:                     responses@,
1723:                     self.unbounded_log_instance@,
1724:                     self.cyclic_buffer_instance@,
1725:                 ),
1726:                 0 <= iteration <= WARN_THRESHOLD,
1727:         {
1728:             let Tracked(ghost_data0) = ghost_data_new;
1729:             let tracked NrLogAppendExecDataGhost {
1730:                 local_updates,
1731:                 ghost_replica,
1732:                 combiner,
1733:                 cb_combiner,
1734:                 request_ids,
1735:             } = ghost_data0;
1736:             let tracked mut cb_combiner = cb_combiner.get();
1737:             // let global_head = self.head.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
1738:             let global_head =
1739:                 atomic_with_ghost!(
1740:                 &self.head.0 => load();
1741:                 returning ret;
1742:                 ghost g => { /* no-op */ }
1743:             );
1744:             // let f = self.tail.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
1745:             let global_tail =
1746:                 atomic_with_ghost!(
1747:                 &self.tail.0 => load();
1748:                 returning ret;
1749:                 ghost g => { /* no-op */ }
1750:             );
1751:             let (min_local_version, cb_combiner0) = self.find_min_local_version(
1752:                 Tracked(cb_combiner),
1753:             );
1754:             let tracked mut cb_combiner = cb_combiner0.get();
1755:             // If we cannot advance the head further, then start
1756:             // from the beginning of this loop again. Before doing so, try consuming
1757:             // any new entries on the log to prevent deadlock.
1758:             if min_local_version == global_head {
1759:                 proof {
1760:                     cb_combiner =
1761:                     self.cyclic_buffer_instance.borrow().advance_head_abort(
1762:                         replica_token.id_spec(),
1763:                         cb_combiner,
1764:                     );
1765:                 }
1766:                 if iteration == WARN_THRESHOLD {
1767:                     print_starvation_warning(line!());
1768:                     // let tracked cb_combiner = Tracked(cb_combiner);
1769:                     // let tracked ghost_data = NrLogAppendExecDataGhost { local_updates, ghost_replica, combiner, cb_combiner, request_ids };
1770:                     // return Tracked(ghost_data);
1771:                     iteration = 0;
1772:                 }
1773:                 let cb_combiner = Tracked(cb_combiner);
1774:                 let tracked ghost_data0 = NrLogAppendExecDataGhost {
1775:                     local_updates,
1776:                     ghost_replica,
1777:                     combiner,
1778:                     cb_combiner,
1779:                     request_ids,
1780:                 };
1781:                 ghost_data_new =
1782:                 self.execute(replica_token, responses, actual_replica, Tracked(ghost_data0));
1783:                 continue ;
1784:             }
1785:             // There are entries that can be freed up; update the head offset.
1786:             // self.head.store(min_local_tail, Ordering::Relaxed);
1787: 
1788:             atomic_with_ghost!(
1789:                 &self.head.0 => store(min_local_version);
1790:                 update old_val -> new_val;
1791:                 ghost g => {
1792:                     cb_combiner = self.cyclic_buffer_instance.borrow().advance_head_finish(replica_token.id_spec(), &mut g, cb_combiner);
1793:             });
1794:             if global_tail < min_local_version + self.slog.len() as u64 - GC_FROM_HEAD as u64 {
1795:                 let cb_combiner = Tracked(cb_combiner);
1796:                 let tracked ghost_data_new = NrLogAppendExecDataGhost {
1797:                     local_updates,
1798:                     ghost_replica,
1799:                     combiner,
1800:                     cb_combiner,
1801:                     request_ids,
1802:                 };
1803:                 return Tracked(ghost_data_new);
1804:             }
1805:             let cb_combiner = Tracked(cb_combiner);
1806:             let tracked ghost_data0 = NrLogAppendExecDataGhost {
1807:                 local_updates,
1808:                 ghost_replica,
1809:                 combiner,
1810:                 cb_combiner,
1811:                 request_ids,
1812:             };
1813:             // replica_token@ < self.local_versions.len(),
1814:             ghost_data_new =
1815:             self.execute(replica_token, responses, actual_replica, Tracked(ghost_data0));
1816:         }
1817:     }

1854:     /// Executes a passed in closure (`d`) on all operations starting from a
1855:     /// replica's local tail on the shared log. The replica is identified
1856:     /// through an `idx` passed in as an argument.
1857:     #[verifier::exec_allows_no_decreases_clause]
1858:     pub(crate) fn execute(
1859:         &self,
1860:         replica_token: &ReplicaToken,
1861:         responses: &mut Vec<DT::Response>,
1862:         actual_replica: &mut DT,
1863:         ghost_data: Tracked<NrLogAppendExecDataGhost<DT>>,
1864:     ) -> (result: Tracked<NrLogAppendExecDataGhost<DT>>)

1866:             self.wf(),
1867:             replica_token@ < self.local_versions.len(),
1868:             ghost_data@.execute_pre(
1869:                 replica_token@,
1870:                 old(actual_replica).view(),
1871:                 old(responses)@,
1872:                 self.unbounded_log_instance@,
1873:                 self.cyclic_buffer_instance@,
1874:             ),
1875:         ensures
1876:             result@.execute_post(
1877:                 ghost_data@,
1878:                 replica_token@,
1879:                 final(actual_replica).view(),
1880:                 old(responses)@,
1881:                 final(responses)@,
1882:                 self.unbounded_log_instance@,
1883:                 self.cyclic_buffer_instance@,
1884:             ),

1886:         let nid = replica_token.id() as usize;
1887:         // somehow can't really do this as a destructor
1888:         let tracked ghost_data = ghost_data.get();

1891:         let tracked mut ghost_replica = ghost_data.ghost_replica.get();  // Tracked<UnboundedLog::replicas>,
1892:         let tracked mut combiner = ghost_data.combiner.get();  // Tracked<UnboundedLog::combiner>,
1893:         let tracked mut cb_combiner = ghost_data.cb_combiner.get();  // Tracked<CyclicBuffer::combiner>,

1895:         let ghost mut request_ids_new = request_ids;

1897:             // if the combiner in idle, we start it with the trival start transition
1898:             if combiner.value().is_Ready() {
1899:                 combiner =
1900:                 self.unbounded_log_instance.borrow().exec_trivial_start(nid as nat, combiner);
1901:                 request_ids_new = Seq::empty();
1902:             }
1903:         }
1904:         // let ltail = self.ltails[idx.0 - 1].load(Ordering::Relaxed);
1905:         let mut local_version =
1906:             atomic_with_ghost!(
1907:             &self.local_versions[nid].0 => load();
1908:             returning ret;

1910:                 // this kicks of the state transition in both the cyclic buffer and the unbounded log
1911:                 combiner = self.unbounded_log_instance.borrow().exec_load_local_version(nid as nat, &g.0, combiner);
1912:                 cb_combiner = self.cyclic_buffer_instance.borrow().reader_start(nid as nat, &g.1, cb_combiner);

1918:         let global_tail =

3047:         // }

3049:             atomic_with_ghost!(

3051:                 &self.combiner.0 => load();
3052:                 ghost g => { }
3053:             );
3054:         if res != 0 {

3056:         }
3057:         // XXX: we should pass in the replica token here, just setting the tid to 1 should work

3060:         let tid = 1u64;
3061:         // Step 1: perform cmpxchg to acquire the combiner lock
3062:         // if self.combiner.compare_exchange_weak(0, 1, Ordering::Acquire, Ordering::Acquire) != Ok(0) {

6634:             ReadonlyState::Done { ret, version_upper_bound, op, .. } => {
6635:                 exists |v: nat| (#[trigger] rangeincl(version_upper_bound, v, self.version_upper_bound))
6636:                     && ret == DT::dispatch_spec(compute_nrstate_at_version(self.log, v), op)
6637:             },
6638:             _ => true,
6639:         }
6640:     }

6643:     /// The results of the updates must match
6644:     /// Inv_UpdateResults(s)
6645:     #[invariant]
6646:     pub fn inv_update_results(&self) -> bool {
6647:         forall |rid| (#[trigger] self.local_updates.contains_key(rid))
6648:             ==>  self.update_results_match(self.local_updates[rid])
6649:     }
6650: 
6651:     pub open spec fn update_results_match(&self, update: UpdateState<DT>) -> bool {
6652:         match update {
6653:             UpdateState::Applied { ret, idx } => {
6654:                 ret == DT::dispatch_mut_spec(compute_nrstate_at_version(self.log, idx), self.log[idx].op).1
6655:             },
6656:             UpdateState::Done { ret, idx } => {
6657:                 ret == DT::dispatch_mut_spec(compute_nrstate_at_version(self.log, idx), self.log[idx].op).1
6658:             },
6659:             _ => true,
6660:         }
6661:     }

6664:     /// All combiners must have distinct request ids they are working on
6665:     /// Inv_CombinerRidsDistinct(s)
6666:     #[invariant]
6667:     pub fn inv_combiner_rids_distinct(&self) -> bool
6668:     {
6669:       forall |node_id1, node_id2|
6670:           (#[trigger] self.combiner.contains_key(node_id1)
6671:           && #[trigger] self.combiner.contains_key(node_id2)
6672:           && node_id1 != node_id2) ==>
6673:             seq_disjoint(self.combiner[node_id1].queued_ops(), self.combiner[node_id2].queued_ops())
6674:     }

6677:     /// the state of the replica must match the current version of the log
6678:     #[invariant]
6679:     pub open spec fn replica_state(&self) -> bool {
6680:         forall |node_id| (#[trigger] self.replicas.contains_key(node_id)) ==>
6681:             self.replicas[node_id] == compute_nrstate_at_version(self.log, self.current_local_version(node_id))
6682:     }

6685:     ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
6686:     // State Machine Initialization
6687:     ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
6688: 
6689:     init!{
6690:         initialize(number_of_nodes: nat) {
6691:             require(number_of_nodes > 0);
6692: 
6693:             init num_replicas = number_of_nodes;
6694:             init log = Map::empty();
6695:             init tail = 0;
6696:             init replicas = Map::new(Set::range(0, number_of_nodes), |n| DT::init_spec());
6697:             init local_versions = Map::new(Set::range(0, number_of_nodes), |n| 0);
6698:             init version_upper_bound = 0;
6699:             init local_reads = Map::empty();
6700:             init local_updates = Map::empty();
6701:             init combiner = Map::new(Set::range(0, number_of_nodes), |n| CombinerState::Ready);
6702:         }
6703:     }
6704: 
6705:     ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
6706:     // Readonly Transitions
6707:     ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
6708: 
6709:     /// Read Request: Read the version of the log
6710:     ///
6711:     /// The algorithm waits while local_version < read_version
6712:     transition!{
6713:         readonly_version_upper_bound(rid: ReqId) {
6714:             remove local_reads -= [ rid => let ReadonlyState::Init { op } ];
6715:             add    local_reads += [ rid => ReadonlyState::VersionUpperBound {
6716:                                                 op, version_upper_bound: pre.version_upper_bound } ];
6717:         }
6718:     }
6719: 
6720:     /// Read Request: wait until the version of the state has reached the version of the log
6721:     ///
6722:     /// The algorithm waits while local_version < read_version
6723:     transition!{
6724:         readonly_ready_to_read(rid: ReqId, node_id: NodeId) {
6725:             remove local_reads    -= [ rid => let ReadonlyState::VersionUpperBound { op, version_upper_bound } ];
6726:             have   local_versions >= [ node_id => let local_head ];
6727: 
6728:             require(local_head >= version_upper_bound);
6729: 
6730:             add local_reads += [ rid => ReadonlyState::ReadyToRead{op, node_id, version_upper_bound} ];
6731:         }
6732:     }
6733: 
6734:     /// Read Request: perform the read request on the local replica, the combiner must not be busy
6735:     transition!{
6736:         readonly_apply(rid: ReqId) {
6737:             remove local_reads -= [ rid => let ReadonlyState::ReadyToRead { op, node_id, version_upper_bound } ];
6738:             have   combiner    >= [ node_id => CombinerState::Ready ];
6739:             have   replicas    >= [ node_id => let state ];
6740: 
6741:             let ret = DT::dispatch_spec(state, op);
6742: 
6743:             add local_reads += [ rid => ReadonlyState::Done{ op, node_id, version_upper_bound, ret } ];
6744:         }
6745:     }
6746: 
6747:     ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
6748:     // Update Transitions
6749:     ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
6750: 
6751:     /// Combiner: Collect the operations and place them into the log
6752:     transition!{
6753:         update_place_ops_in_log_one(node_id: NodeId, rid: ReqId) {
6754:             // Only allowing a single request at a time
6755:             // (in contrast to the seagull one which does it in bulk).
6756:             // Hopefully this leads to some easier proofs.
6757:             remove combiner      -= [ node_id => let CombinerState::Placed{ queued_ops } ];
6758:             remove local_updates -= [ rid => let UpdateState::Init{ op }];
6759: 
6760:             update tail = pre.tail + 1;
6761:             add log           += [ pre.tail => LogEntry{ op, node_id }];
6762:             add local_updates += [ rid => UpdateState::Placed{ op, idx: pre.tail }];
6763:             add combiner      += [ node_id => CombinerState::Placed { queued_ops: queued_ops.push(rid) } ];
6764:         }
6765:     }
6766: 
6767:     transition!{
6768:         update_done(rid:ReqId) {
6769:             remove local_updates -= [ rid => let UpdateState::Applied { ret, idx } ];
6770: 
6771:             // we must have applied the
6772:             require(pre.version_upper_bound > idx);
6773: 
6774:             add local_updates += [ rid => UpdateState::Done { ret, idx } ];
6775:         }
6776:     }
6777: 
6778:     /*/// Update: Remove a finished update from the system
6779:     transition!{
6780:         update_finish(rid:ReqId) {
6781:             remove local_updates -= [ rid => let UpdateState::Done { ret, idx } ];
6782:         }
6783:     }*/
6784:

6786:     ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
6787:     // Combiner Execute Transitions
6788:     ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
6789: 
6790: 
6791:     /// Combiner: start the combiner to execute the update operations on the local replica
6792:     transition!{
6793:         exec_trivial_start(node_id: NodeId) {
6794:             remove combiner -= [ node_id => CombinerState::Ready ];
6795: 
6796:             add    combiner += [ node_id => CombinerState::Placed { queued_ops: Seq::empty() } ];
6797:         }
6798:     }
6799: 
6800:     /// Combiner: read the version of the local replica
6801:     transition!{
6802:         exec_load_local_version(node_id: NodeId) {
6803:             remove combiner      -= [ node_id => let CombinerState::Placed { queued_ops } ];
6804: 
6805:             have   local_versions >= [node_id => let lversion];
6806: 
6807:             add    combiner      += [ node_id => CombinerState::LoadedLocalVersion { queued_ops, lversion }];
6808:         }
6809:     }
6810: 
6811:     /// Combiner: read the global tail
6812:     transition!{
6813:         exec_load_global_head(node_id: NodeId) {
6814:             remove combiner -= [ node_id => let CombinerState::LoadedLocalVersion { queued_ops, lversion } ];
6815: 
6816:             add    combiner += [ node_id => CombinerState::Loop { queued_ops, lversion, idx: 0, tail: pre.tail } ];
6817:         }
6818:     }
6819: 
6820:     /// Combiner: Safety condition, the queue index must be within bounds
6821:     property!{
6822:         pre_exec_dispatch_local(node_id: NodeId) {
6823:             have combiner >= [ node_id => let CombinerState::Loop{ queued_ops, lversion, tail, idx } ];
6824:             have log      >= [ lversion => let log_entry ];
6825: 
6826:             require(log_entry.node_id == node_id);
6827:             require(lversion < tail);
6828:             assert(idx < queued_ops.len()) by {
6829:                 // assert(pre.wf_combiner_for_node_id(node_id));
6830:                 // assert(lversion < tail);
6831:                 // assert(pre.log.index(lversion).node_id == node_id);
6832:             };
6833:             assert(queued_ops.len() > 0);
6834:         }
6835:     }
6836: 
6837:     /// Combiner: dispatch a local update and apply it to the local replica and record the outcome of the update
6838:     transition!{
6839:         exec_dispatch_local(node_id: NodeId) {
6840:             remove combiner      -= [ node_id => let CombinerState::Loop { queued_ops, lversion, tail, idx } ];
6841:             remove replicas      -= [ node_id => let old_nr_state ];
6842:             let rid = queued_ops.index(idx as int);
6843:             remove local_updates -= [ rid => let local_update ];
6844: 
6845:             have log >= [lversion => let log_entry];
6846: 
6847:             // require(local_update.is_Placed());
6848: 
6849:             // apply all updates between lhead and global tail that were enqueued from local node
6850:             require(lversion < tail);
6851:             require(log_entry.node_id == node_id);
6852:             let (new_nr_state, ret) = DT::dispatch_mut_spec(old_nr_state, log_entry.op);
6853: 
6854:             add local_updates += [ rid => UpdateState::Applied { ret, idx: lversion }];
6855:             add replicas      += [ node_id => new_nr_state];
6856:             add combiner      += [ node_id => CombinerState::Loop { queued_ops, lversion: lversion + 1, tail, idx: idx + 1}];
6857:         }
6858:     }
6859: 
6860:     /// Combiner: dispatch a remote update and apply it to the local replica
6861:     transition!{
6862:         exec_dispatch_remote(node_id: NodeId) {
6863:             remove combiner -= [ node_id => let CombinerState:: Loop { queued_ops, lversion, tail, idx } ];
6864:             remove replicas -= [ node_id => let old_nr_state ];
6865: 
6866:             have   log      >= [ lversion => let log_entry ];
6867: 
6868:             // apply all updates between lhead and global tail that were enqueued from remote nodes
6869:             require(lversion < tail);
6870:             require(log_entry.node_id != node_id);
6871:             let (new_nr_state, ret) = DT::dispatch_mut_spec(old_nr_state, log_entry.op);
6872: 
6873:             add replicas    += [ node_id => new_nr_state ];
6874:             add combiner    += [ node_id => CombinerState::Loop { queued_ops, lversion: lversion + 1, tail, idx}];
6875:         }
6876:     }
6877: 
6878:     /// Combiner: Safety condition, if we applied all updates, idx must be the length of the list
6879:     property!{
6880:         pre_exec_update_version_upper_bound(node_id: NodeId) {
6881:             have combiner >= [ node_id => let CombinerState::Loop{ queued_ops, lversion, tail, idx } ];
6882: 
6883:             require(lversion == tail);
6884:             assert(idx == queued_ops.len()) by {
6885:                 // assert(pre.wf_combiner_for_node_id(node_id));
6886:                 // assert(lversion == tail);
6887:             };
6888:         }
6889:     }
6890: 
6891:     /// Combiner: update the version upper bound when all updates have been applied to the local replica
6892:     transition!{
6893:         exec_update_version_upper_bound(node_id: NodeId) {
6894:             remove combiner -= [ node_id => let CombinerState::Loop { queued_ops, lversion, tail, idx, }];
6895: 
6896:             // we applied all updates up to the global tail we've read
6897:             require(lversion == tail);
6898: 
6899:             // assert(idx == queued_ops.len()) by {
6900:             //     //assert(pre.wf_combiner_for_node_id(node_id));
6901:             // };
6902: 
6903:             update version_upper_bound = if pre.version_upper_bound >= tail {
6904:                 pre.version_upper_bound
6905:             } else {
6906:                 tail
6907:             };
6908:             add combiner += [ node_id => CombinerState::UpdatedVersion { queued_ops, tail } ];
6909:         }
6910:     }
6911: 
6912:     /// Combiner: is done, bump the local version and combiner returns to ready state
6913:     transition!{
6914:         exec_finish(node_id: NodeId) {
6915:             remove combiner       -= [ node_id => let CombinerState::UpdatedVersion { queued_ops, tail } ];
6916:             remove local_versions -= [ node_id => let old_local_head ];
6917: 
6918:             // here have the local updates updated to done.
6919: 
6920:             add    local_versions += [ node_id => tail ];
6921:             add    combiner       += [ node_id => CombinerState::Ready ];
6922:         }
6923:     }
6924: 
6925:     /// Combiner: is done, without any change
6926:     transition!{
6927:         exec_finish_no_change(node_id: NodeId) {
6928:             remove combiner -= [ node_id => let CombinerState::LoadedLocalVersion { queued_ops, lversion } ];
6929: 
6930:             require(lversion == pre.tail);
6931:             assert(queued_ops.len() == 0);
6932: 
6933:             add    combiner += [ node_id => CombinerState::Ready];
6934:         }
6935:     }

7114:             post.replicas[nid] == compute_nrstate_at_version(post.log, post.current_local_version(nid)) by
